title: Crackers Tape Goreng - Fried Fermented Cassava Crackers
ldName: Crackers Tape Goreng - Fried Fermented Cassava Crackers
ldKeywords: How to make deep-fried crackers sandwich
Easy Indonesian crackers sandwich with tape (fermented cassava)
ldIngredientsRaw: 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon powder (Indonesian: bubuk kayu manis)
50 gram all purpose flour (Indonesian: tepung terigu)
ldInstructionsRaw: Mix together mashed fermented cassava and cinnamon powder. Divide into 8 portions.
Sandwich 1 portion of the fermented cassava with 2 crackers. Repeat until you get 8 sandwiches. Set aside.
Combine all coating batter ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix well.
Coat each sandwich with the coating batter and deep fry in hot oil until crispy and golden brown. Drain on wire rack/paper towel.
Serve immediately with hot tea or hot coffee.
